title: follow-up of #36544: after FormView modalSize retires, update the QA checklist view.form row and the @object-ui/types taxonomy comment
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① (b) review nit N2 on PR #38168 (#36544), contract review 7235062576: the two edits the PR defers by ruling have no card. Source: fleet.
Grading: area:build · Task · p3 · reach: QA runs of the Studio authoring checklist and readers of the `@object-ui/types` form-view taxonomy after 19.0 · evidence: PR #38168 body, Acceptance notes (head fa4a7b40).
Dedupe: "modalSize checklist", "objectql.ts modalSize" → only #36544 and PR #38168.
Blocked-by: #38168

## 维护者速读

- 问题：表单视图的 `modalSize`（弹窗大小）在 19 退役（#38168）。那个 PR 按裁定没有动两处旁边的文字：QA 测试清单里还把它记成「今天失败的一行」，ui 类型包的一段注释还把它列为表单视图的键。
- 修法：#38168 合入后，改这两处文字，与退役一致。
- 要你做的：无。

## Ask (after #38168 merges)

1. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`, the `view.form` row: it still records `modalSize` as a row that fails today. Update the row to the retired key (the item now expects the parse refusal that #38168 ships, or the row drops `modalSize`, as the checklist's own conventions say), and keep `check-platform-checklist` green.
2. `ui/packages/types/src/objectql.ts`: the taxonomy comment lists `modalSize` among form view keys. Remove it, with an `@object-ui/types` patch changeset if the comment ships in the package's sources.

## Done when

- Neither file names `modalSize` as a live form-view key.
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` and the `@object-ui/types` gates exit 0.
